images.name: KW3D-E-fit_a
images.prompt: EDIT the first attached image, variant a of the painted knight walk sheet. Correct the background defect: REPLACE ALL dark gray/black/brown gradient background with a SINGLE SOLID PURE BRIGHT GREEN RGB(0,255,0), hexadecimal #00ff00. This green is an opaque chroma-key plate, not transparency. Absolutely every background pixel, including holes between arms, legs and weapons, must be the same flat green. No mottling, shading, gradients, halo, vignette or shadows. The second attached image is the original geometry sheet: restore its exact figure outlines, locations, limb poses, foot positions and pollaxe lines wherever the paint-over drifted. Keep twelve frames in precisely the same four-column three-row positions and reading order. Keep the painted character identity and ink/watercolor treatment from the first attached image, as approved by the third attached image; the fourth attached image shows under-tabard armour and mail. Do not let the mail skirt expand beyond the original figure silhouette. Preserve matching armour, blue/gold cross and diagonal-band heraldry, red lining and forward pollaxe blades across all twelve frames. Crisp dark sepia pen contours, fine drawn hatching and pale transparent uneven watercolor with soft upper-left daylight. Only correct the backdrop and silhouette fidelity. Exact 1536x1024 PNG, no text or cell borders. Flat opaque #00ff00 background is mandatory.
